**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User has a cat named Luna.
- [EVENT] User purchased a 5-tier cat tower from Petco for $120 on sale.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on cat behavior.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is normal for cats to prefer the highest point in their territory, as it provides security, comfort, and a good view.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cats often lounge in elevated areas to feel safe, observe their surroundings, relax, and survey their territory.
- [EVENT] User has been trying to manage Luna's shedding by brushing her regularly with a Furminator brush.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular brushing is one of the most effective ways to manage shedding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should brush Luna 2-3 times a week and consider using a slicker brush or pin brush in between Furminator sessions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bathing Luna every 2-3 months can help reduce shedding, but over-bathing should be avoided.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A high-quality diet rich in omega-3 fatty acids can promote a healthy coat and reduce shedding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should keep their home clean by regularly vacuuming and dusting.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Changing air filters every 1-2 months can help reduce airborne hair and dander.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Using a humidifier can help maintain moisture levels in the home, reducing shedding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reducing stress in Luna's environment can also help manage shedding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consult their vet if Luna's shedding persists or is accompanied by health issues.
- [EVENT] User has started using a deshedding spray on Luna.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User can use the deshedding spray 1-2 times a week, either before or after brushing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Deshedding sprays can help loosen and remove undercoat, making brushing more effective.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should monitor Luna's response to the deshedding spray and adjust usage accordingly.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended deshedding sprays include Furminator deShedding Spray, Oster Oatmeal Dog & Cat Shampoo and Deshedding Spray, Earthbath All-Natural Deshedding Spray, and Pet Head FURminator Deshedding Spray.
- [EVENT] User is trying to keep track of Luna's expenses, including 12 packets of 2kg Whiskas food purchased from Petco in bulk about 10 days ago.
